Thanks for helping make recipes better! Fill in the details below and a maintainer will add your annotation.

## Recipe

Which recipe is this for? (e.g., Pumpkin Doughnut)

## Element

Which ingredient or step does this apply to? Copy the exact text:

## Annotation Type

- [ ] Substitution (replaces/swaps an ingredient or modifies a step)
- [ ] Tip (helpful advice, no replacement)

## Your Suggestion

What's the substitution or tip?

## Your Name (for attribution)

How should we credit you? (e.g., GitHub username or display name)
